decision.caveat: This is a lower-bound inertial mass sum and gross-area force screen. If an alternate continuous structural path exists physically but is not represented in CAD/spec, actual tube stress is not inferable from this cut alone.
decision.serial_path_implication: For the modeled serial path, the 0.5 mm body_upper wall is the only modeled solid crossing the 0.50 m cut; no continuous recovery backbone or other modeled solid spans the cut. A local bulkhead/spreader near 0.225 m cannot by itself bypass the upper tube segment. A continuous lightweight recovery tether/backbone into an aft structural attachment is a candidate direction only if a future explicit design shows a continuous load path; no adoption or strength credit.

mass_accounting.mass_rule: Include only parts whose saved station start is at/after 0.50 m and whose saved CAD role is not distributed_budget; use geometry.length_m or bbox_m[0] as extent; no straddling component is counted wholly aft.
